method: Five reader profiles distilled from existing source-audited dossier records. The profiles reuse only the listed factual claims and their explicit study scopes; no source prose, coordinates, tables, figures, or images are reproduced.

sections.locator: Methods, Behavioral Observations and Feeding Event Locations; Results, Habitat Use and Preferences and Distance of Feeding Events in Noncultivated Habitat Relative to Cultivated Fields and Routes; Table II.
sections.scope: Bossou, Guinea; April 2012–March 2013; one wild P. t. verus community and ten adult focal individuals.

sections.locator: Abstract; Results, Maturation milestones, Table 2 and Figure 1; Discussion.
sections.scope: Gombe National Park, Tanzania; known-age wild females; first-birth timing comes from a smaller censored subset and may be biased low.

sections.locator: Abstract; Methods (b); Results, Development of hand grips; Discussion.
sections.scope: Taï National Park, Côte d’Ivoire; 70 wild western chimpanzees, 135 videos and 1,460 events from three neighboring communities; cross-sectional age data.

targets.rightsAndLimits: Bryson-Morrison and Malherbe sources are CC BY 4.0; Walker is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The profile uses attributed factual paraphrases only. Site, population, age-sampling, and task boundaries remain visible; no range-wide inference is made.

sections.locator: Materials and Methods, Geographic distribution and Gap analysis; Results, Geographic distribution; Fig. 1.
sections.scope: Ecuador; 60 roosting locations from seven satellite-tagged birds and seven environmental predictors at 500 m resolution.

sections.locator: Abstract; census methods; Results, Population size and Population viability; Discussion.
sections.scope: Two-day synchronized census on 2015-09-29 and 2015-09-30; abundance extrapolation and viability scenarios concern Ecuador, not a current global reassessment.

targets.rightsAndLimits: PLOS article states CC BY 4.0. Model areas, census counts, and viability results are limited to Ecuador and the study period; the guide does not state a current Red List category.

sections.locator: Results, Genome-wide SNP typing; Methods, Sample collection; Fig. 1a.
sections.scope: Six East Antarctic colonies; genetic material collected 2004–2012; locations are the study sampling frame.

sections.locator: Abstract; Results, Genome-wide SNP typing; Discussion; Methods, Sample collection.
sections.scope: RAD-SNP data from 110 birds at six colonies; migration parameters average across generations.

targets.rightsAndLimits: Nature Communications article states CC BY 4.0. Findings are bounded to the study's sampled colonies and coalescent model; no current census or instantaneous dispersal rate is inferred.

sections.locator: Executive Summary; Geographic Distribution, Breeding Colonies.
sections.scope: North Pacific synthesis with population and occurrence evidence through 2005; source-era breeding proportion, not a current global atlas.
